title: Helen L Possible NDE 6919
content: Myself, three of my teenage children, and 1 friend were floating down the Illinois River. It had rained quite a lot a 2 weeks prior to us going on the float. The river was running fast and rough. Our raft was being forced toward a huge treetop toward the right of the river in very deep water. The tree had numerous huge limbs coming out of the trunk and you could see more below the water and around that area. Our raft hit one of the huge limbs, my friend tried to push against it, and it snapped back and knocked me off the raft. The raft was quite large, a 4-seater. When I fell into the water, I got trapped under the raft and in the limbs of the tree below. I was following the bottom of the raft with my hands trying to get to the end of it so I could get back in. Between the force of the water, the limbs below and not being able to move the raft or find an end to it, I could not return to the surface. I remember thinking, 'I'm not going to get out of this'. In a split second of panic, quickly I felt my body relax and calmness came over me, I closed my eyes and all I saw was blackness. It was peaceful, no fear at all, just nothingness. It was a few minutes later, I felt being grabbed from behind and my eyes opened when my daughter, Sarah, had found me and pulled me to the top surface, I remember the touch of her hands and feeling like I was being pulled back from somewhere; and then opening my eyes just as I came to the surface. Luckily, my daughters were watching the current and looking for me. It was a miracle they found me. I was very distraught and could not get into the raft. I held on to the side of it until we could get to shore. I went into shock I think, shaking uncontrollably, and crying. My friend drove us home. Once I was home, showered and laid in my own bed I felt much better. I dreamt about it for several nights and it took a while for me to get past the experience. I still have a very clear vision of myself and how I felt when I almost drowned. FYI: I considered myself a strong swimmer, I taught swimming lessons and was a lifeguard myself when I was younger. I taught all four of my now grown children to swim. But I could not get myself out of the situation of being stuck between a huge raft and a huge tree in the river.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Near-drowning after being knocked off a raft and trapped under it and tree limbs in the Illinois River.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Panic followed by sudden calm; perceived blackness/nothingness; then being physically pulled to the surface by her daughter.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience described as peaceful blackness/nothingness during near-drowning, without OBE, tunnel, beings, or light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I'm not going to get out of this"; "I closed my eyes and all I saw was blackness. It was peaceful, no fear at all, just nothingness."; "feeling like I was being pulled back from somewhere".
